items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: I played music with him with Georgie Parker Band... Him and I worked on the same jobs together.

ctx.x: Because I got out the music business. I was so interested in traveling and plastering business.
That's why I lost a year I'm a plasterer. I guess you knew Johnny St. Cyr, did you? Good friend of mine.
I played music with him with Georgie Parker Band at Happyland and out the lake. We played there about four years.
